steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: At the next council meeting, I'm going to recommend that we change the guards' uniform to be red.

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: We have surface-dwellers coming down into our mines and our city now, and remember that they don't have very good eyesight.

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: I worry that they can't see our guards very clearly in the dark. It is important for a guard to be seen.

steps.npc: You have a point. But I don't think red would be the best colour. It is the colour of blood, so it might give the wrong impression.

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: What colour do you suggest, then?

steps.npc: I suggest green. I have heard that the plants that grow on the surface are mostly green, so surface-dwellers might find that colour soothing.

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: No, I disagree. Guards should not be soothing, they should be seen as formidable. Red will give the correct impression.

steps.npc: Oh, hello surface-dweller. We were just discussing some council business.

options.text: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

steps.player: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: No, thank you. We don't let any one single goblin make decisions, and certainly not an outsider!

steps.npc: But we could do with an opinion. What colour do you think is best?

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: Thank you, surface-dweller. That's what I'll be recommending in the next meeting.

steps.npc: Thank you, surface-dweller. That's what I'll be recommending in the next meeting.

options.text: I think the guards are fine as they are

steps.player: I think the guards are fine as they are.

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: Perhaps you're right. Not making any change would certainly be the easiest option!

options.text: I think I've been here before...

steps.player: I think I've been here before...
This is a lot like a conversation I had with some goblins on the surface.

steps.npc: Really? Which armour colour did they pick?

steps.player: They ended up with the same armour colour that they started with!

steps.speaker: Ur-lun
steps.text: You know, I think that's probably what we'll end up doing.
